name: Landingfolio

sources.title: Submit page — submissions are a member perk; $1.99/week or $59 lifetime membership required

requirements: Submissions require a paid Landingfolio membership ($1.99/week or $59 one-time 'forever') — 'Submissions are a member perk'
Curated gallery: 'A curator reviews every submission. Most don't make it in.'
Accepted: a live page for a real product with strong typography, colour and layout; loads fast; works on mobile; your own work or a page you admire
Rejected: template demos, placeholder copy, broken or under-construction pages
preparation: Live landing page URL (yours or one you admire — third-party nominations allowed)
Confidence the page passes a design bar: typography, colour, layout, speed, mobile
workflow: Buy a membership at /pricing ($1.99/week or $59 forever)
Open /submit and paste the live landing page URL
Automated pre-filter screenshots the page, then a human curator approves or rejects
Approved pages go live in the gallery; you get an email and can track submissions from your profile
watchFor: Source-claimed 'paid' pricing is confirmed — there is no free submission path
Membership also unlocks the Tailwind/Webflow/Figma component library, so the fee isn't purely a listing fee
Automated pre-filter may fail on JS-heavy or bot-blocking pages
Rejection is common — this is an editorial gallery, not a guaranteed listing
countsAsLive: The landing page appears as an entry in the Landingfolio inspiration gallery (reachable via /inspiration/landing-page browsing) and the confirmation email arrives
unknowns: Whether the listing link is dofollow
Whether you can submit a page you don't own without the owner's involvement (site says 'a page you admire' is acceptable)
